title: Parking fines with immunity
hook: Two stated cases: explore the enforceability of a stated sanction.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the enforceability of a stated sanction affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Net, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the enforceability of a stated sanction in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
